subject: Avoid unnecessary dict shrink in zremrangeGenericCommand (#13143)
reason: The change only skips dictShrinkIfNeeded on a sorted set's dict when the ZREMRANGEBY* delete emptied it and dbDelete is about to free the entire object anyway; when members remain the shrink still runs as before. It is a performance-only refactor with no observable change to replies, keyspace events, data, encoding, or replication, so there is nothing a scenario could detect.
